title: Web app uses the cloud backend and bucket in production
description: The deployed web app reads amplify_outputs.json from the deployment (AppSync API + Storage bucket, Cognito auth instead of the local API key), fetches audio and metadata from the bucket via the same library-relative keys as local /files/, and the hero plays from the synced assets. Coordinate any web/src/ui change through this issue (the web session owns visuals). Depends on apricitus-25e216 (S3 Files + sync) and apricitus-9bd3ef (hero rewrite).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Hero part done (bootstrap() called at startup; guest read on files/hero/*). STILL OPEN: Library and Score screens still call the local Python server (/api/samples, /api/scores, /api/score, /api/annotations, /api/upload in web/src/apricity.ts) and 404 on the deployed site; they need the cloud data layer + sign-in.
